title: A.R.M.O.R. command to the panel of an alarm node
description: A command to one ARMOR-ALARM node, published by the server to armor/alarm/{node_id}/command (never retained): arm in `away` or `stay`, or disarm. A disarm carries no PIN: the PIN is for whoever stands at the panel, and the authority of the server is the broker's access list plus the node's own setting. An arm carries its `mode` and may carry `force`; a disarm carries neither a mode nor `force: true`. A node with commands off, or a command that is not exactly this, gets no answer at all.

command_id.description: Chosen by the server: sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits; the node repeats it in its result.

mode.description: Only on an arm, and required there.

force.description: Only on an arm: leave out the zones that are open (never a sounding smoke detector or panic button).
